name: manual-resource
description: Scaffold a resource that Vrooli can describe and partially validate without promising full automated lifecycle ownership.

RESOURCE_PORTABILITY_TIER.description: Portability tier for the generated scaffold.

RESOURCE_CLI_COMMAND.description: Installed command name for the generated resource CLI.

platformExpectations: The generated scaffold should document prerequisites and validation probes instead of pretending full install automation exists.
Manual resources must state their limits explicitly.
